slice.target: Cargo Reference / Source Replacement / local-registry configuration
slice.finding: Cargo officially documents source replacement in .cargo/config.toml. A source can be defined with local-registry = "path/to/registry", and another source such as crates-io can select a replacement using replace-with. The same official page defines a local registry source as a registry subset available on the local filesystem, downloaded ahead of time, containing crate archives and an index.
slice.verified_scope: The official Cargo documentation supports configuring source replacement to select a local-registry path through Cargo configuration, so source selection itself can point at local filesystem registry state rather than a remote registry endpoint once that local registry already exists.
slice.not_verified_scope: Creation or population of the local registry without Cargo/process execution; whether every dependency-resolution command avoids all network access in every configuration; Cargo execution from scheduled Chat; Chat-native transfer of crate archives/index into a local filesystem; end-to-end richer-mode outcome parity.
slice.scope_guard: This is configuration-path evidence only. It does not prove that recurring scheduled Chat can create the required local registry, run Cargo, or complete an end-to-end build without a richer execution surface.
